subject: ClearBridge hosting constraints & next technical deep-dive
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@clearbridgehealth.com>, Sara Monroe <sara@clearbridgehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

Subject: ClearBridge hosting constraints & next technical deep-dive

Hi Tom / Sara — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the concrete asks we captured on the call so we’re all aligned. If I missed anything, please flag.

Key pain & drivers
- Regulatory: ClearBridge must ensure PHI processing is restricted to customer-managed network segments and demonstrate controls for audit (SOC2 + CMS audit readiness).
- No outbound internet from model runtime: clinical review workflows cannot allow model containers to reach public internet (egress blocked).
- Data residency: training/embeddings and runtime logs must remain in us-east-1 and be retainable for up to 7 years per compliance team.
- Key management: BYOK/HSM requirement for encryption of stored model artifacts and logs.

Concrete goals we heard
- Proof-of-concept (POC) that demonstrates inference within a private VPC or air-gapped facility with no internet egress.
- Clear list of required network constructs (subnets, routing, firewall rules) and any gateway-level appliances we’d need to support.
- Rough cost + timeline for Dedicated VPC deployment vs. on-prem appliance option.

Constraints / clarifying items needed from you
1) Can you share the current network topology (subnets, NAT/GW, transit gateway, firewall vendor) — see attachment request.
2) Confirm whether ClearBridge will accept a customer-managed NAT/firewall that Redwood routes through, or whether only an on-prem isolated deploy is permitted.
3) Procurement contact to receive a POC SOW and initial pricing (we can include both Dedicated and On-Prem options).

Next steps (proposed)
- Tech deep-dive (60–75m) to cover architecture options, firewall rules, and KMS flow — propose Wed 2026-11-18 14:00 ET.
- You share a one-page topology diagram + list of IP ranges and FWs prior to the call.
- Redwood to prepare an air-gap options one-pager and Dedicated VPC checklist (attached draft).

Attachments I’ll send separately: redwood-airgap-options-onepager.pdf (short options matrix) and a checklist for network inventory.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scoped.

—
Mina Haddad

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-11-13T09:12:00Z
Subject: Fwd: ClearBridge hosting constraints & next technical deep-dive — internal alignment

Ben / Laura — forwarding the client topology and their asks. High-level internal notes and recommended approach: 

Summary of asks
- No egress from clinical subnets; transit-gw + PA NGFW enforced.
- Must use customer-managed KMS (HSM) and keep all logs in us-east-1.

Recommended options to propose in deep-dive
1) Dedicated VPC deployment (preferred path if customer allows): deploy Redwood runtime inside ClearBridge VPC with strict security groups, route through their NGFW for outbound control, and integrate with customer KMS via IAM role and external key wrap. Pros: faster onboarding, lower CAPEX. Cons: we must validate that our telemetry/metrics pipeline can operate without direct internet (need to use private endpoints or a metrics relay).
2) On-prem sealed deployment: fully isolated appliance in their datacenter or co-lo. Pros: meets tightest compliance; Cons: longer delivery, ops overhead.
3) Hybrid: edge inference in customer environment for PHI-sensitive traffic + Redwood hosted for non-PHI.

Action items
- Ben: validate BYOK/HSM flow and produce a one-page KMS integration sketch by EOD 11/16.
- Laura: draft two SOW bullets (Dedicated VPC POC + On-Prem pilot) for procurement and attach pricing ranges.
- Mina: schedule the tech deep-dive (proposed 11/18 14:00 ET) and share a pre-call checklist.

Keep this high level in the external meeting; let’s avoid committing to timelines until we validate KMS and metrics relays.

—
Mina
